title: Genesys Dice Forge
description: Dedicated native-WebGL 3D narrative dice module for Genesys. Zero-config automatic Genesys roll capture, rendered-chat fallback, integrated chat-toolbar launcher, three randomized physical roll profiles, premium physical dice, authentic face composition, natural deterministic face-up settling, always-on-top presentation, standalone roll simulator, adaptive audio, Foundry VTT 13.351 and Version 14.
